source: |
  SELECT
    s.invoice_id,
    s.line_no,
    s.invoice_date,
    s.week_start,
    s.customer_id,
    s.branch_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.category,
    s.quantity,
    s.list_unit_price_usd,
    s.discount_pct,
    s.net_revenue_usd,
    s.cogs_usd,
    s.currency,
    s.rebate_alloc_usd,
    p.plan_gross_margin_pct,
    b.branch_name,
    b.region,
    c.customer_name,
    c.segment AS customer_segment,
    c.industry_segment,
    c.account_manager,
    c.payment_terms_days,
    c.credit_limit_usd,
    ar.due_date,
    ar.invoice_amount_usd,
    ar.paid_amount_usd,
    ar.open_balance_usd,
    ar.as_of_date,
    ar.dispute_date,
    COALESCE(
      f.freight_cost_usd * s.net_revenue_usd
        / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY s.week_start, s.branch_id), 0),
      0
    ) AS freight_alloc_usd
  FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_sales_line_rebate_alloc s
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_plan_gross_margin p
    ON s.category = p.category AND s.period_month = p.period_month
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_branch b
    ON s.branch_id = b.branch_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_customer c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_ar_invoice ar
    ON s.invoice_id = ar.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_freight f
    ON s.week_start = f.week_start AND s.branch_id = f.branch_id

dimensions:
  - name: Week Start
    expr: week_start
    comment: Monday of the invoice week, used as the primary time grain for weekly dashboards
  - name: Category
    expr: category
    comment: Product category, used by category managers to investigate margin leakage
  - name: Branch
    expr: branch_name
    comment: Selling branch name
  - name: Region
    expr: region
    comment: Geographic region of the selling branch
  - name: Customer Segment
    expr: customer_segment
    comment: Customer segment such as Trade, Retail, Industrial or Government
  - name: Industry Segment
    expr: industry_segment
    comment: Industry classification of the customer
  - name: Account Manager
    expr: account_manager
    comment: Account manager responsible for the customer relationship
  - name: Currency
    expr: currency
    comment: Transaction currency of the sales line
  - name: Invoice Date
    expr: invoice_date
    comment: Date the invoice was raised
  - name: Due Date
    expr: due_date
    comment: Payment due date on the AR invoice, used by credit control
  - name: As Of Date
    expr: as_of_date
    comment: Snapshot date for the AR balance, used to age receivables
  - name: Payment Terms Days
    expr: payment_terms_days
    comment: Contractual payment terms in days for the customer
  - name: Credit Limit USD
    expr: credit_limit_usd
    comment: Approved credit limit for the customer in USD

measures:
  - name: Net Revenue
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd)
    comment: Invoiced revenue after discounts in USD
  - name: List Revenue
    expr: SUM(quantity * list_unit_price_usd)
    comment: Revenue at full list price before any discounts in USD
  - name: COGS Reported
    expr: SUM(cogs_usd)
    comment: Reported cost of goods sold after supplier rebate netting in USD
  - name: Rebate Accrual Allocated
    expr: SUM(rebate_alloc_usd)
    comment: Supplier rebate accrual allocated to each sales line in USD
  - name: COGS Pre Rebate
    expr: MEASURE(`COGS Reported`) + MEASURE(`Rebate Accrual Allocated`)
    comment: Cost of goods sold before any supplier rebate benefit is recognised in USD
  - name: Gross Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Reported`)
    comment: Net revenue minus reported COGS (after rebate accrual) in USD
  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Pre Rebate`)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual is applied in USD
  - name: Gross Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Reported gross margin as a share of net revenue
  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual as a share of net revenue
  - name: Gross Margin Reported Pct
    expr: (MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Reported`)) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Gross margin as reported after rebate accrual as a share of net revenue
  - name: Plan Gross Margin USD
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd * plan_gross_margin_pct / 100)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin derived from revenue-weighted plan rate in USD
  - name: Plan Gross Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin percentage, revenue-weighted by category and period
  - name: GM vs Plan Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pct`) - MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Reported gross margin gap versus plan in basis points, negative means leakage
  - name: Rebate Impact Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Reported Pct`) - MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Basis point uplift to gross margin from supplier rebate accrual
  - name: Discount Leakage USD
    expr: MEASURE(`List Revenue`) - MEASURE(`Net Revenue`)
    comment: Revenue given away through discounting versus list price in USD
  - name: Price Realisation Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`List Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Fraction of list price actually captured as net revenue
  - name: Freight Cost USD
    expr: SUM(freight_alloc_usd)
    comment: Outbound freight cost allocated pro-rata to revenue within week and branch in USD
  - name: Contribution Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) - MEASURE(`Freight Cost USD`)
    comment: Gross margin after deducting allocated freight cost in USD
  - name: Contribution Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Contribution Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Contribution margin as a share of net revenue after freight
  - name: Invoice Lines
    expr: COUNT(1)
    comment: Number of sales invoice lines in the selection
  - name: Open AR
    expr: SUM(open_balance_usd)
    comment: Total unpaid AR balance as of the snapshot date in USD
  - name: Billed Last 90 Days
    expr: SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(as_of_date, 89) AND as_of_date THEN invoice_amount_usd END)

source: |
  SELECT
    s.invoice_id,
    s.line_no,
    s.invoice_date,
    s.week_start,
    s.customer_id,
    s.branch_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.category,
    s.quantity,
    s.list_unit_price_usd,
    s.discount_pct,
    s.net_revenue_usd,
    s.cogs_usd,
    s.currency,
    s.rebate_alloc_usd,
    p.plan_gross_margin_pct,
    b.branch_name,
    b.region,
    c.customer_name,
    c.segment AS customer_segment,
    c.industry_segment,
    c.account_manager,
    c.payment_terms_days,
    c.credit_limit_usd,
    ar.due_date,
    ar.invoice_amount_usd,
    ar.paid_amount_usd,
    ar.open_balance_usd,
    ar.as_of_date,
    ar.dispute_date,
    COALESCE(
      f.freight_cost_usd * s.net_revenue_usd
        / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY s.week_start, s.branch_id), 0),
      0
    ) AS freight_alloc_usd
  FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_sales_line_rebate_alloc s
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_plan_gross_margin p
    ON s.category = p.category AND s.period_month = p.period_month
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_branch b
    ON s.branch_id = b.branch_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_customer c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_ar_invoice ar
    ON s.invoice_id = ar.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_freight f
    ON s.week_start = f.week_start AND s.branch_id = f.branch_id

  - name: Currency

  - name: Invoice Date

  - name: Credit Limit USD
    expr: credit_limit_usd
    comment: Approved credit limit for the customer in USD

measures:
  - name: Net Revenue
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd)
    comment: Invoiced revenue after discounts in USD
  - name: List Revenue
    expr: SUM(quantity * list_unit_price_usd)
    comment: Revenue at full list price before any discounts in USD
  - name: COGS Reported
    expr: SUM(cogs_usd)
    comment: Reported cost of goods sold after supplier rebate netting in USD
  - name: Rebate Accrual Allocated
    expr: SUM(rebate_alloc_usd)
    comment: Supplier rebate accrual allocated to each sales line in USD
  - name: COGS Pre Rebate
    expr: MEASURE(`COGS Reported`) + MEASURE(`Rebate Accrual Allocated`)
    comment: Cost of goods sold before any supplier rebate benefit is recognised in USD
  - name: Gross Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Reported`)
    comment: Net revenue minus reported COGS (after rebate accrual) in USD
  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Pre Rebate`)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual is applied in USD
  - name: Gross Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Reported gross margin as a share of net revenue
  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual as a share of net revenue
  - name: Gross Margin Reported Pct
    expr: (MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Reported`)) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Gross margin as reported after rebate accrual as a share of net revenue
  - name: Plan Gross Margin USD
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd * plan_gross_margin_pct / 100)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin derived from revenue-weighted plan rate in USD
  - name: Plan Gross Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin percentage, revenue-weighted by category and period
  - name: GM vs Plan Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pct`) - MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Reported gross margin gap versus plan in basis points, negative means leakage
  - name: Rebate Impact Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Reported Pct`) - MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Basis point uplift to gross margin from supplier rebate accrual
  - name: Discount Leakage USD
    expr: MEASURE(`List Revenue`) - MEASURE(`Net Revenue`)
    comment: Revenue given away through discounting versus list price in USD
  - name: Price Realisation Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`List Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Fraction of list price actually captured as net revenue
  - name: Freight Cost USD
    expr: SUM(freight_alloc_usd)
    comment: Outbound freight cost allocated pro-rata to revenue within week and branch in USD
  - name: Contribution Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) - MEASURE(`Freight Cost USD`)
    comment: Gross margin after deducting allocated freight cost in USD
  - name: Contribution Margin Pct
    expr: MEASURE(`Contribution Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)
    comment: Contribution margin as a share of net revenue after freight
  - name: Invoice Lines
    expr: COUNT(1)
    comment: Number of sales invoice lines in the selection
  - name: Open AR
    expr: SUM(open_balance_usd)
    comment: Total unpaid AR balance as of the snapshot date in USD
  - name: Billed Last 90 Days
    expr: SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(as_of_date, 89) AND as_of_date THEN invoice_amount_usd END)
    comment: Total invoiced amount in the 90 days up to the snapshot date in USD
  - name: DSO Days
    expr: MEASURE(`Open AR`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Billed Last 90 Days`) / 90, 0)
    comment: Days sales outstanding calculated as open AR divided by average daily billings over 90 days
  - name: Past Due Over 30 Days
    expr: SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(as_of_date, due_date) > 30 THEN open_balance_usd END)
    comment: Open AR balance more than 30 days past due date in USD, key metric for credit control

    expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dispute_date IS NOT NULL THEN open_balance_usd END)
    comment: Open AR balance on invoices that have been flagged as disputed in USD

  Week Start COMMENT 'Monday of the invoice week, used as the primary time grain for weekly dashboards',
  Category COMMENT 'Product category, used by category managers to investigate margin leakage',

  As Of Date COMMENT 'Snapshot date for the AR balance, used to age receivables',
  Payment Terms Days COMMENT 'Contractual payment terms in days for the customer',
  Credit Limit USD COMMENT 'Approved credit limit for the customer in USD',
  Net Revenue COMMENT 'Invoiced revenue after discounts in USD',
  List Revenue COMMENT 'Revenue at full list price before any discounts in USD',
  COGS Reported COMMENT 'Reported cost of goods sold after supplier rebate netting in USD',
  Rebate Accrual Allocated COMMENT 'Supplier rebate accrual allocated to each sales line in USD',
  COGS Pre Rebate COMMENT 'Cost of goods sold before any supplier rebate benefit is recognised in USD',
  Gross Margin USD COMMENT 'Net revenue minus reported COGS (after rebate accrual) in USD',
  Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD COMMENT 'Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual is applied in USD',
  Gross Margin Pct COMMENT 'Reported gross margin as a share of net revenue',
  Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct COMMENT 'Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual as a share of net revenue',
  Gross Margin Reported Pct COMMENT 'Gross margin as reported after rebate accrual as a share of net revenue',
  Plan Gross Margin USD COMMENT 'FP&A plan gross margin derived from revenue-weighted plan rate in USD',
  Plan Gross Margin Pct COMMENT 'FP&A plan gross margin percentage, revenue-weighted by category and period',
  GM vs Plan Bps COMMENT 'Reported gross margin gap versus plan in basis points, negative means leakage',
  Rebate Impact Bps COMMENT 'Basis point uplift to gross margin from supplier rebate accrual',
  Discount Leakage USD COMMENT 'Revenue given away through discounting versus list price in USD',
  Price Realisation Pct COMMENT 'Fraction of list price actually captured as net revenue',
  Freight Cost USD COMMENT 'Outbound freight cost allocated pro-rata to revenue within week and branch in USD',
  Contribution Margin USD COMMENT 'Gross margin after deducting allocated freight cost in USD',
  Contribution Margin Pct COMMENT 'Contribution margin as a share of net revenue after freight',
  Invoice Lines COMMENT 'Number of sales invoice lines in the selection',
  Open AR COMMENT 'Total unpaid AR balance as of the snapshot date in USD',
  Billed Last 90 Days COMMENT 'Total invoiced amount in the 90 days up to the snapshot date in USD',
  DSO Days COMMENT 'Days sales outstanding calculated as open AR divided by average daily billings over 90 days',
  Past Due Over 30 Days COMMENT 'Open AR balance more than 30 days past due date in USD, key metric for credit control',
  Disputed AR COMMENT 'Open AR balance on invoices that have been flagged as disputed in USD')
COMMENT 'Acme Corp data product metric view, built from the reviewed spec. SYNTHETIC data.'
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS
$$
version: 1.1

source: |-
  SELECT
    s.invoice_id,
    s.line_no,
    s.invoice_date,
    s.week_start,
    s.customer_id,
    s.branch_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.category,
    s.quantity,
    s.list_unit_price_usd,
    s.discount_pct,
    s.net_revenue_usd,
    s.cogs_usd,
    s.currency,
    s.rebate_alloc_usd,
    p.plan_gross_margin_pct,
    b.branch_name,
    b.region,
    c.customer_name,
    c.segment AS customer_segment,
    c.industry_segment,
    c.account_manager,
    c.payment_terms_days,
    c.credit_limit_usd,
    ar.due_date,
    ar.invoice_amount_usd,
    ar.paid_amount_usd,
    ar.open_balance_usd,
    ar.as_of_date,
    ar.dispute_date,
    COALESCE(
      f.freight_cost_usd * s.net_revenue_usd
        / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_revenue_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY s.week_start, s.branch_id), 0),
      0
    ) AS freight_alloc_usd
  FROM vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_sales_line_rebate_alloc s
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_plan_gross_margin p
    ON s.category = p.category AND s.period_month = p.period_month
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_branch b
    ON s.branch_id = b.branch_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_dim_customer c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_ar_invoice ar
    ON s.invoice_id = ar.invoice_id
  LEFT JOIN vmohan_demo_catalog.cfo_workbench.gold_fct_freight f
    ON s.week_start = f.week_start AND s.branch_id = f.branch_id

comment: "Acme Corp data product metric view, built from the reviewed spec. SYNTHETIC\
  \ data."

dimensions:
  - name: Week Start
    expr: week_start
    comment: "Monday of the invoice week, used as the primary time grain for weekly\
      \ dashboards"

  - name: Category
    expr: category
    comment: "Product category, used by category managers to investigate margin leakage"

  - name: Branch
    expr: branch_name
    comment: Selling branch name

  - name: Region
    expr: region
    comment: Geographic region of the selling branch

  - name: Customer Segment
    expr: customer_segment
    comment: "Customer segment such as Trade, Retail, Industrial or Government"

  - name: Industry Segment
    expr: industry_segment
    comment: Industry classification of the customer

  - name: Account Manager
    expr: account_manager
    comment: Account manager responsible for the customer relationship

  - name: Currency
    expr: currency
    comment: Transaction currency of the sales line

  - name: Invoice Date
    expr: invoice_date
    comment: Date the invoice was raised

  - name: Due Date
    expr: due_date
    comment: "Payment due date on the AR invoice, used by credit control"

  - name: As Of Date
    expr: as_of_date
    comment: "Snapshot date for the AR balance, used to age receivables"

  - name: Payment Terms Days
    expr: payment_terms_days
    comment: Contractual payment terms in days for the customer

  - name: Credit Limit USD
    expr: credit_limit_usd
    comment: Approved credit limit for the customer in USD

measures:
  - name: Net Revenue
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd)
    comment: Invoiced revenue after discounts in USD

  - name: List Revenue
    expr: SUM(quantity * list_unit_price_usd)
    comment: Revenue at full list price before any discounts in USD

  - name: COGS Reported
    expr: SUM(cogs_usd)
    comment: Reported cost of goods sold after supplier rebate netting in USD

  - name: Rebate Accrual Allocated
    expr: SUM(rebate_alloc_usd)
    comment: Supplier rebate accrual allocated to each sales line in USD

  - name: COGS Pre Rebate
    expr: MEASURE(`COGS Reported`) + MEASURE(`Rebate Accrual Allocated`)
    comment: Cost of goods sold before any supplier rebate benefit is recognised in
      USD

  - name: Gross Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Reported`)
    comment: Net revenue minus reported COGS (after rebate accrual) in USD

  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Pre Rebate`)
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual is applied in USD

  - name: Gross Margin Pct
    expr: "MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)"
    comment: Reported gross margin as a share of net revenue

  - name: Gross Margin Pre Rebate Pct
    expr: "MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`),\
      \ 0)"
    comment: Gross margin before supplier rebate accrual as a share of net revenue

  - name: Gross Margin Reported Pct
    expr: "(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) - MEASURE(`COGS Reported`)) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net\
      \ Revenue`), 0)"
    comment: Gross margin as reported after rebate accrual as a share of net revenue

  - name: Plan Gross Margin USD
    expr: SUM(net_revenue_usd * plan_gross_margin_pct / 100)
    comment: FP&A plan gross margin derived from revenue-weighted plan rate in USD

  - name: Plan Gross Margin Pct
    expr: "MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)"
    comment: "FP&A plan gross margin percentage, revenue-weighted by category and\
      \ period"

  - name: GM vs Plan Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pct`) - MEASURE(`Plan Gross Margin Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: "Reported gross margin gap versus plan in basis points, negative means\
      \ leakage"

  - name: Rebate Impact Bps
    expr: (MEASURE(`Gross Margin Reported Pct`) - MEASURE(`Gross Margin Pre Rebate
      Pct`)) * 10000
    comment: Basis point uplift to gross margin from supplier rebate accrual

  - name: Discount Leakage USD
    expr: MEASURE(`List Revenue`) - MEASURE(`Net Revenue`)
    comment: Revenue given away through discounting versus list price in USD

  - name: Price Realisation Pct
    expr: "MEASURE(`Net Revenue`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`List Revenue`), 0)"
    comment: Fraction of list price actually captured as net revenue

  - name: Freight Cost USD
    expr: SUM(freight_alloc_usd)
    comment: Outbound freight cost allocated pro-rata to revenue within week and branch
      in USD

  - name: Contribution Margin USD
    expr: MEASURE(`Gross Margin USD`) - MEASURE(`Freight Cost USD`)
    comment: Gross margin after deducting allocated freight cost in USD

  - name: Contribution Margin Pct
    expr: "MEASURE(`Contribution Margin USD`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Net Revenue`), 0)"
    comment: Contribution margin as a share of net revenue after freight

  - name: Invoice Lines
    expr: COUNT(1)
    comment: Number of sales invoice lines in the selection

  - name: Open AR
    expr: SUM(open_balance_usd)
    comment: Total unpaid AR balance as of the snapshot date in USD

  - name: Billed Last 90 Days
    expr: "SUM(CASE WHEN invoice_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(as_of_date, 89) AND as_of_date\
      \ THEN invoice_amount_usd END)"
    comment: Total invoiced amount in the 90 days up to the snapshot date in USD

  - name: DSO Days
    expr: "MEASURE(`Open AR`) / NULLIF(MEASURE(`Billed Last 90 Days`) / 90, 0)"
    comment: Days sales outstanding calculated as open AR divided by average daily
      billings over 90 days

  - name: Past Due Over 30 Days
    expr: "SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(as_of_date, due_date) > 30 THEN open_balance_usd\
      \ END)"
    comment: "Open AR balance more than 30 days past due date in USD, key metric for\
      \ credit control"

  - name: Disputed AR
    expr: SUM(CASE WHEN dispute_date IS NOT NULL THEN open_balance_usd END)
    comment: Open AR balance on invoices that have been flagged as disputed in USD
$$
